evidence.note: Wide upper drawer immediately left of the stove is fully closed.
User is pulling the drawer outward; contents have become visible.
Drawer is clearly open and remains open during the following traversal.
User holds the still-open drawer front and begins pushing it inward.
Drawer is fully closed again.

events.object_description: Wide food-storage drawer directly left of the stove

evidence.note: Wooden cabinet doors above the stove are closed.
User reaches to the central seam and begins opening the left door of the cabinet above the range hood.
Left cabinet door is open, revealing stored bottles and containers.
The left door remains open near the end of the cabinet episode.
User reaches into the cabinet area immediately before the doors are shut.
All cabinet doors above the stove are closed.

events.object_description: Left door of the central upper cabinet above the range hood

evidence.note: Only the first cabinet door is clearly open; the companion door is not yet established as open.
Camera is close to an edge-on cabinet panel while the opening configuration is changing.
Both distinct hinged doors of the central cabinet are visibly open.
Both cabinet doors remain open.
The right-hand door is still visibly projecting outward shortly before closure.
The right-hand door is closed along with the rest of the cabinet front.

events.object_description: Right door of the central upper cabinet above the range hood

evidence.note: Top utensil drawer beneath the air fryer is closed.
User grasps its handle and starts pulling.
Drawer is open, exposing foil boxes, cloths, and utensils.
Drawer remains open immediately before the closing action.
User finishes pushing the drawer closed.
Drawer is fully closed and stays closed.

events.object_description: Top utensil drawer beneath the air fryer, right of the stove

notes: Four localized movable-part episodes are visible. The two independently hinged upper-cabinet doors are reported separately; their opening and especially closing actions occur close together, so their individual timing is less certain than the drawer events.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, opens and closes a wide food-storage drawer, separately opens and closes the two doors of the upper cabinet above the stove, and then opens and closes a utensil drawer beneath the air fryer.
